question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

TON ∶ YTS ∶∶ LAR ∶ ?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

__Consonants are coded by reverse positional value and vowels are written in alphabetical order as shown below:__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66d2069ff4f88495aba42947c4ecfd121e3608db7cea2c5b7a8174459bc1477b.png] 

The pattern for this code is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebcdab141806db4175b9828d6918b0a323ba604a99e0bbab7d7fb3be7b0d9d34.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c84355997c0e5be21f340aad040fcf79695abc9ab4d75d531ddd6d3dfd60b448.png] 

Hence, **LAR** is coded as **QFW.**
